rules: telemetry drop-off rates are clamped between 0.0 and 1.0 and adjusted by subtracting the known double-count defect at step 3; moderated session verbatim texts are normalized to lowercase, trimmed, and stripped of markdown syntax; survey response values are interpolated using linear regression on known skew distribution bands; competitive feature lists are retyped as JSON arrays with missing entries replaced by empty array; all numeric fields carry units in labels such as percentage or count; rounding occurs at the final output stage to two decimal places for percentages and whole numbers for counts; any interpolation uses pre-defined reference points from supplied survey data
invariants: output must contain exactly one entry per input record with no duplicates or omissions; every drop-off rate must be between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive and validated against telemetry step data; every verbatim text must have a corresponding finding_type and persona; all derived percentages must sum to 100% across segments and be traceable to raw survey counts; any gap in evidence is explicitly marked with [gap] or [unknown_response] and not inferred
